verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm, a professional legal-services provider rather than a software platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a category error for this product type. Its legaltech offerings are a questionnaire-driven document generator with a Docusign integration, a HighQ-hosted deal room and AI review tools, and none of them mention webhooks or an event API. The probes found no OpenAPI or llms.txt surface either.
